comment: Recorded by ServiceControlRuntimeTests.NativeHyperBoostOwnedVectors; regenerate with OPENBLADE_REGENERATE_NATIVE_HYPERBOOST_OWNED_VECTORS set to this directory. Each row creates the pad-less HyperBoost context on the row's source with RZ09-0581's HyperBoost bases (Silent, Balanced, Performance and Custom, with direct entry from manual fans) and the default saved profiles, confirms the row's state, observes once, then calls SetHyperBoostAsync(enabled) with the cooling pad in the row's state. Where ProductionBatteryPort's entry precondition refuses the confirmed state (a battery preset with Automatic fans), the device throws that precondition's known-not-applied refusal. Each row records the reply and the HyperBoost and performance writes the runtime made.
